details.direction: Point-to-point from Miller Street, North Sydney, to the Sydney Opera House
details.distanceMethod: Official 42.195 km from the 2026 course page. The World Athletics results page lists the men's and women's marathon, and no competing official distance figure was found.
details.elevationMethod: Official 2026 course page elevation profile: +313 m gain, −396 m loss and −83 m net. The same page's course-information text also labels 313 m as net elevation gain and 396 m as net elevation loss, and states that GPX elevation is not 100 per cent accurate. This card uses the official +313 m headline figure.
details.attribution: TCS Sydney Marathon presented by ASICS. The official course page offers a GPX download but publishes no redistribution licence, so this site does not host, draw or bundle the track.
